summary.text: Maurice McCaney is the Republican candidate for Alabama House of Representatives District 1 in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026.
He previously ran for the seat in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Maurice McCaney ran in the Republican primary for Alabama House of Representatives District 1 on May 24, 2022, and was defeated by incumbent Phillip Pettus.
